title: Mention Input
content: Build @mention input component. Trigger: type @ to show suggestions. Popup: dropdown of users/entities to mention. Search: filter suggestions as typing. Selection: click or enter to insert mention. Display: render mentions as styled tags. Keyboard: arrow keys navigate suggestions. Multiple: support multiple mentions in single input. Data: pass selected mentions as structured data.

variants.detailed: Build @mention input component. Trigger: type @ to show suggestions. Popup: dropdown of users/entities to mention. Search: filter suggestions as typing. Selection: click or enter to insert mention. Display: render mentions as styled tags. Keyboard: arrow keys navigate suggestions. Multiple: support multiple mentions in single input. Data: pass selected mentions as structured data.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive @mention input with suggestion popup. Input type: contentEditable div or textarea (contentEditable for inline styling). Trigger detection: detect @ character, capture text after @ until space or special char. Suggestion popup: absolute positioned below cursor or input, show filtered list of mentionable entities. Search: filter suggestions by name or username, fuzzy matching, debounce filter (150ms). Suggestion item: avatar, name, username/title, keyboard highlight on current selection. Selection: click or Enter inserts mention, replace @query with mention. Mention display: styled inline (bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 px-1 rounded), non-editable unit, delete whole mention on backspace. Data structure: track mentions separately ({id, name, position}), or use special Unicode characters as markers. Multiple mentions: support many mentions in single input, each triggers independently. Escape: Escape closes popup without selecting. Navigation: arrow up/down moves selection, wrap around, scroll into view. Empty/loading: show loading spinner while fetching, "No users found" if empty. Entity types: support different mention types (@user, #channel, :emoji:) with different triggers and sources. Cursor positioning: place cursor after inserted mention. Validation: validate mentions still exist on submit (user not deleted). Backend format: convert to ID references for storage, display names for rendering. Accessibility: aria-autocomplete, announce suggestions count, announce selection. Libraries: tribute.js, react-mentions for complex implementations.
